tools.name: graphify
tools.purpose: Local AST structural code graph (graphify CLI, code-only extract)
tools.installNotes: pip install graphifyy==0.9.28 into .hyperpower/tools/graphify-venv; copy Scripts/graphify.exe to bin/. Hooks resolve via scripts/githook-locate-graphify.sh.
tools.exitPlan: Remove venv + graphify.exe; drop graphify-out/ from manifest workflow; remove from hyperpower.json required tools.
